justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/stage/StageManager.java and IStageClosedListener.java. The package is a shared coordination hub: 7 classes import it (JITWatchUI, MainConfigStage, NothingMountedStage, SandboxStage, SandboxConfigStage, VMLanguageConfigStage, VMLanguageList), so it has substantial incoming dependency. Its own project-level outgoing dependencies are narrow: StageManager only imports IMetaMember, ICompilationChangeListener, ReportStage, and UserInterfaceUtil, while IStageClosedListener only depends on javafx.stage.Stage. This does not show the package depending heavily on less-stable packages than itself.
